To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a grasp synthesis algorithm based postural synergies has been developed and validated on a robotic arm-hand platform.

the algorithm has been developed for an anthropomorphic robot hand with 16 degrees of freedom and that the algorithm has demonstrated its ability to synthesize a large set of grasps in a low dimensional space.
a grasp synthesis algorithm based upon human postural synergies can be implemented on a low dimensional posture space and can be used to control an arm-hand robotic platform.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an anthropomorphic robot hand that can perform grasping tasks in a human-like manner.
the study of the human grasping behavior and with the development of a grasp synthesis method for an anthropomorphic robot arm-hand system.
the study of the human hand synergies in order to develop an anthropomorphic robotic hand able to perform grasping tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed algorithm is able to generate the desired hand preshaping and wrist pose for a given object, thus allowing for a fast and reliable grasp of the target object.
the grasp synthesis algorithm is capable to synthesize hand postures that are similar to human ones, and it can be implemented in an anthropomorphic armhand robotic system.

the proposed grasp synthesis algorithm has demonstrated to be effective and reliable in generating hand configurations and arm postures that allow the arm-hand robotic platform to successfully grasp objects of different shape and size.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the grasp synthesis algorithm based postural synergies can provide an efficient and reliable solution for the control of the anthropomorphic robot arm-hand system.

we developed a novel grasp synthesis algorithm for a humanoid robotic arm hand based on human postural synergies, we developed an experimental setup to test our algorithm and finally we validated our algorithm in simulation and in the real world.
the grasp synthesis algorithm is able to synthesize hand configurations that are compliant with the human grasping strategy and that are able to be reproduced by a robot arm-hand system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed grasp synthesis algorithm can be successfully used in the context of a robotic arm-hand system for grasping tasks.
it is possible to develop an algorithm for grasp synthesis based on the analysis of the postural synergies of the hand.
the proposed algorithm can be used as the basis of a grasp synthesis module for an anthropomorphic robot hand.
